checkpoint_semantics: Four unpromoted last-legal diagnostic anchors, including failed/in-progress D; not selected RF candidates.

costs.semantics: Per-attempt costs include per-arm initialization allocation; shared preparation actual is counted once, not as an additional arm cost. D is the last saved meter snapshot. CPU/wall per arm excludes separate allocated initialization timing.

limitations: Experiment stopped during nominal-D; D remains in_progress in raw and Sobol A/B/C/D were not started.
All checkpoints are last legal diagnostic anchors, non-promoted and not RF eligible.
No separate 17-point, dense 1001-point, independent MNA/power/SPD validation was performed.
Raw originals are local only, are not recoverable from Git, and must be retained until a separate preservation decision.
No feasibility, method superiority, global optimum, continuous-frequency or physical implementation claim.
Initialization and raw stage observations are not independent validation; no new RF samples were evaluated during extraction.
